Name: Perish Body Fix
Description: Perish Body's counter is packed at bit 8 of the status word set on contact. Verified live in the Expansion build: Battle.cro offset 0x1117F0 holds 03 AC 8A E3, which decodes as ORR R10, R10, #0x300 - packing counter value 3 instead of the correct 4 (Perish Song / Perish Body should always start the countdown at 4 turns until fainting on the 0 turn). Flips the single immediate byte so the instruction becomes ORR R10, R10, #0x400 (04 AC 8A E3). Byte-for-byte read and confirmed from the actual RomFS Battle.cro before authoring this patch; not a guess.
